$comment: AgentNotify harness example for Muse Code (beta). Merge the schema_version and hooks into ~/.config/muse/settings.json and replace HOOK_DIR with the folder holding agentnotify_hook.py. Prefer `agentnotify install-harness muse`. schema_version 1 is required: a settings file without it fails every Muse command at startup. The hook only notifies and never blocks. After installing, start one session and confirm Muse reports no hooks warning.
